fr_html: D'autre part il ne semble pas moins certain que tout projet qui ne tiendra compte de l'opinion publique de certains grands Etats, de la Grande Bretagne par exemple, comme l'a expliqué Lord Phillimore, entraînera l'échec de notre œuvre.
en_html: On the other hand, it seemed no less certain, that any project, which does not take into consideration public opinion in certain of the great Powers, Great-Britain, for example, as Lord Phillimore had explained, would mark the failure of our work.
